partners.mechanism_chain: PRNP pathogenic variant (null) —DISRUPTS→ PRNP (HGNC:9444); PRNP (HGNC:9444) —LEADS_TO→ Prion disease phenotype (HP:0002123); CACNA1C gain-of-function variant (null) —DISRUPTS→ CACNA1C (HGNC:1376); CACNA1C (HGNC:1376) —BINDS→ L-type calcium channel activity (GO:0005257); L-type calcium channel activity (GO:0005257) —LEADS_TO→ Long QT syndrome (HP:0011674); Long QT syndrome (HP:0011674) —LEADS_TO→ Arrhythmia (HP:0011414); L-type calcium channel activity (GO:0005257) —LEADS_TO→ Arrhythmia (HP:0011414).
